workspaceSetup.title: First, decide how content should enter
workspaceSetup.subtitle: OpenWiki keeps one canonical model: Library for raw material, Knowledge for structure, Insights for analysis. The only thing you need to choose first is who manages the content source.
workspaceSetup.libraryDesc: All raw material lands here first. Clipboard captures, imported files, and synced RAW folders all become library items.
workspaceSetup.knowledgeDesc: OpenWiki turns library material into reusable structure such as cases, concepts, themes, and dashboards.
workspaceSetup.insightsDesc: Insights are not a separate store. They analyze the activity already living in your Library and Knowledge layers.
workspaceSetup.modeDesc: Managed storage and connected folders share the same product model. You can revisit this later.
workspaceSetup.modeManagedDesc: OpenWiki stores content in its own local app folder. Best for starting from scratch.
workspaceSetup.modeConnectedDesc: Bring in your own RAW folders, note folders, or knowledge base, and let OpenWiki visualize and analyze them.
workspaceSetup.modeHybridDesc: Let OpenWiki manage new captures while also connecting your existing folders into the same workspace.
workspaceSetup.mappingDesc: Whether content comes from OpenWiki's local store or from your own folders, it will be mapped into Library, Knowledge, and Insights. Anything unclear stays in the Library first, then gets organized over time.
workspaceSetup.workspaceRootDesc: OpenWiki initializes the shared directory protocol here: inbox, raw, wiki, and insights. New captures are written here instead of living only inside the app database.
workspaceSetup.localRawDesc: Good for RAW, journals, articles, trading notes, inbox folders, and other source material.
workspaceSetup.localWikiDesc: Good for existing cases, concepts, themes, dashboards, or any Markdown-based knowledge structure you already maintain.
workspaceSetup.connectedNeedsPath: If you choose “Connect an existing knowledge base”, connect at least one raw-material folder or one structured knowledge path first.
workspaceSetup.summaryDesc: Content can come from different places while still flowing into one consistent workspace model.
workspaceSetup.summaryStorageManaged: Content starts in OpenWiki's managed local storage, and you can connect outside folders later.
workspaceSetup.summaryStorageConnected: OpenWiki primarily reads from your own folders while handling visualization, linking, and analysis internally.
workspaceSetup.summaryStorageHybrid: OpenWiki combines its own local store with your connected folders, all sharing the same knowledge layer.
workspaceSetup.laterHint: This is not a one-time choice. You can reopen the guide from Settings later to connect more folders or switch source strategy.
